story_text: As a user, I want the profile endpoint to return unauthorized when I am not logged in so that private data is protected.

positive.title: Return unauthorized error when accessing profile endpoint without authentication
steps: 1. Attempt to access the profile endpoint without providing authentication credentials.
positive.expected_result: The system returns an unauthorized error message.

positive.title: Return 401 status code for unauthenticated profile request
steps: 1. Attempt to access the profile endpoint without providing authentication credentials.
positive.expected_result: The system returns a 401 status code.

negative.title: Allow access to profile endpoint without authentication
steps: 1. Attempt to access the profile endpoint without providing authentication credentials.
negative.expected_result: The system allows access to the profile endpoint without requiring authentication.

negative.title: Return incorrect status code (e.g., 200 or 500) instead of unauthorized
steps: 1. Attempt to access the profile endpoint without providing authentication credentials.
negative.expected_result: The system returns an incorrect status code.

edge.title: Access profile endpoint with expired authentication token
steps: 1. Attempt to access the profile endpoint with an expired authentication token.
edge.expected_result: The system returns an unauthorized error message.

edge.title: Access profile endpoint under high request frequency without authentication
steps: 1. Attempt to access the profile endpoint without providing authentication credentials.
edge.expected_result: The system returns an unauthorized error message.
